stages.notes: AUD-013 (workout-progression v1) classified this stage key as PLACEHOLDER_UNCONFIRMED ('invented for pilot completeness'); no v5-anchored re-confirmation entry exists. AUD-014/AUD-015 classify min/maxExposures and compression/extensionBehavior as PLACEHOLDER_UNCONFIRMED (invented, no canonical dosage source) for v1; AUD-320/AUD-310 cascade notes confirm these values were carried forward unchanged through v2-v5, so the same unconfirmed classification applies to v5's actual values.

AUD-013/AUD-014/AUD-015 (see FOUNDATION_EASY_BASE note) apply identically: stage key, exposure bounds, and compression/extension behavior remain PLACEHOLDER_UNCONFIRMED for their originating version, carried forward unchanged to v5.

AUD-010 (brief-sourced, CANONICAL_CONFIRMED for v1's ordering '1. TEN_K_SPECIFIC_INTRO, 2. GOAL_PACE_REHEARSAL'): DIRECT link quality for relativeOrder=1 specifically; exposure bounds/compression/extension remain PLACEHOLDER_UNCONFIRMED (AUD-014/015 lineage).

The single most evidence-linked stage in the catalog. AUD-010/011/012 (brief-sourced, DIRECT for the ordering/requires/fallback shape) plus AUD-424 (DIRECT, confirms v5's exact structure byte-identical to v4 except the GOAL_PACE_TEN_K v1->v2 reference) plus activation-readiness-risks.md risk TD-WAVE5-001 (DIRECT, explicitly about v10: notes the AllowGoalPaceRehearsal flag is never actually read by any runtime guard -- GOAL_FEASIBILITY_IN is the only real gate). Exposure bounds remain PLACEHOLDER_UNCONFIRMED (AUD-014 lineage).

This stage's own requires is empty -- it is unconditionally eligible once reached, so the GOAL_PACE_REHEARSAL fallback chain always terminates successfully in v10's actual data (no unresolved-terminal-fallback scenario exists today).

Only TAPER stage; EASY_STANDARD workout key, not a distinct 'race-week workout' -- no RACE-family workout definition is referenced by any stage anywhere in v10's progression, though the master template's own TAPER phase eligibleWorkoutFamilies explicitly permits QUALITY and RACE (AUD-007).

complexityTier.notes: Absent by schema design for schemaVersion 3 (workout-definition.schema.json forbids complexityTier when schemaVersion is not 1 or 2); removed at WAVE3 (AUD-313).

eligibleLevels.notes: No 'eligibleLevels' concept exists on WORKOUT_DEFINITION; level eligibility is governed entirely by which LEVEL_MODIFIER documents list this workout in their own eligibleWorkouts array (inverted ownership, not a field on the workout itself).

componentSchema.notes: No components array present -- valid per schema (EASY_STANDARD is continuous; AUD-302 confirms components are optional/omitted by design, not missing data).

dosageFieldsAllowedBySchema.notes: Schema has no explicit numeric-dosage field at all (distance/duration/volume); prescription mode governs only which ACCOUNTING category applies, not a stored numeric target.

No mapping into GeneratedCatalogWorkoutType {Easy,Interval,Tempo,LongRun,RecoveryEasy} exists either.

runtimeEligibilityConditions.resolverImplementation: backend/RunningApp.Application/RuntimeCatalog/Resolvers/GoalFeasibilityResolver.cs (Phase 4C/4D) -- implemented; outputs GoalFeasibilityResolutionStatus values including Realistic/Challenging/Unsupported/NotRequested per repository's own established resolver pattern.
runtimeEligibilityConditions.currentReachability: This stage's requires is the ONLY runtime-condition reference anywhere in v10's workoutProgression -- confirmed by direct inspection of ten-k-workout-progression.v5.json (single 'requires' block in the whole document) and by AUD-406 ('repository-wide search... found zero references to PACE_SOURCE_IN, TIME_ADEQUACY_IN, or CORE_ENTRY_READINESS_IN outside the registry artifact itself').

fallbackChains.terminalOutcomeIfAllFallbacksIneligible: NOT_REACHABLE_IN_V10 -- CURRENT_FITNESS_SPECIFIC_REHEARSAL has requires=[] and is therefore always eligible once reached; no scenario in the current catalog data causes the entire chain to fail. General terminal-failure behavior (what happens if a fallback chain's last stage is itself ineligible) is not represented anywhere in the current catalog/validator contract -- classified MISSING/OPEN_DECISION for any FUTURE stage that might have both a fallback and a conditional fallback target, which does not exist in v10 today.
fallbackChains.derivationRule: graph traversal of fallbackStageKey references within one phaseProgression, validated by WorkoutProgressionValidator.DetectCircularFallback and TemplateCombinationValidator's TC_STAGE_UNREACHABLE reachability check

mechanicallyImpliedByValidatedFamilyCons.note: Checks CLOSURE membership only (progression stage candidates UNION level-modifier eligibleWorkouts) -- not stage schedulability. LONG_RUN_STANDARD satisfies this check via level-modifier membership alone; zero stages actually target it.

missingRequiringLaterDecision: Exact WORKOUT (not merely family) selection per structural role per week -- no catalog field or validator states this at any granularity finer than family-closure membership.

How the LONG_RUN role is ever populated at all, given zero workout-progression stages target the LONG_RUN family in v10 -- LONG_RUN_STANDARD is reachable only via level-modifier eligibleWorkouts, never via a stage.

Backend runtime (RunningApp.Application.RuntimeCatalog.Schedule.Materialization) treats StructuralRole as an opaque string end-to-end (CatalogRunLayoutSlots/CatalogWeekSkeletonCalendarMaterializer) -- confirmed by source inspection; no role-to-family or role-to-workout logic exists in the backend at all, so this catalog-side (Process A tooling) mapping is not currently consumed by Process B (backend) in any form.

undocumentedAssumptions.assumption: Backend runtime consumes zero workout-progression stage-level fields today (relativeOrder, workoutCandidates, minimumExposures, maximumExposures, compressionBehavior, extensionBehavior, requires, fallbackStageKey).
undocumentedAssumptions.location: backend/RunningApp.Application/RuntimeCatalog/PlanCatalogBundleLoader.cs, PlanCatalogCandidateSummary.cs (confirmed via direct source search: zero references to WorkoutCandidate/workoutCandidates)
undocumentedAssumptions.currentEffect: Phase 4F.2's CatalogStageToWeekMaterializer treats 'stage' as the PHASE-level phaseKey (FOUNDATION/BUILD/...) only, not the finer catalog stageKey. No behavior is currently broken by this since nothing reads the finer data, but it means the entire per-stage authoring surface audited here is presently inert in the running backend.

undocumentedAssumptions.assumption: LONG_RUN_STANDARD is assumed reachable/usable for the LONG_RUN structural role despite zero workout-progression stages referencing it.
undocumentedAssumptions.currentEffect: CandidatePublishGraphValidator's LAYOUT_SLOT_HAS_NO_ELIGIBLE_WORKOUT check passes for the LONG_RUN role purely via level-modifier list membership, not via any actually-schedulable stage. A future scheduler assuming 'the layout-coverage validator passing means every role has a reachable stage' would be wrong.

undocumentedAssumptions.assumption: PilotCatalogStructuralTests.cs ('golden' structural test) hardcodes obsolete artifact versions (TEN_K_MASTER v2, RUN_LAYOUT_4D v1, INTERMEDIATE_PROGRESSION_MODIFIER_V1 v1, PEAK_VOLUME_BANDS_V1 v2, INTERMEDIATE_MODIFIER v1, TEN_K_WORKOUT_PROGRESSION_V1 v1, RUNTIME_CONDITION_VALUES_V1 v1) that no longer match the versions v10 actually references.
undocumentedAssumptions.currentEffect: No automated test in this file directly exercises v10's actual dependency graph; D13GoalPaceTenKResolutionTests.cs (BuildBundle(10)) is the only test that resolves the literal v10 bundle end-to-end, and it does so generically (assembly/version assertions) rather than re-asserting the 'golden' structural claims (layout slot shape, core-cycle sum, etc.) against v10 specifically.

undocumentedAssumptions.assumption: A stage's single-candidate workoutCandidates array (every v10 stage has exactly one candidate) means candidate ranking/selection-among-multiple-candidates is untested and unspecified.
undocumentedAssumptions.currentEffect: No JSON-array-order-implies-ranking assumption is currently exercised anywhere for v10, since there is never more than one candidate to rank. This is a latent, not yet manifest, question for any future multi-candidate stage.

undocumentedAssumptions.assumption: GOAL_PACE_TEN_K's schema-required complexityTier (=2) and INTERMEDIATE_PROGRESSION_MODIFIER_V1 v2's absence of maximumComplexityTier together mean the complexity-tier gate cannot currently be mechanically evaluated for v10's dependency graph at all.
undocumentedAssumptions.location: plan-catalog/schemas/progression-modifier.schema.json (maximumComplexityTier forbidden for schemaVersion != 1); plan-catalog/catalog/progression-modifiers/intermediate-progression-modifier.v2.json (schemaVersion 2, no such field)
undocumentedAssumptions.currentEffect: The audit task's own question 'whether all candidate complexity tiers are allowed by the progression modifier, if represented by current contracts' cannot be answered as TRUE or FALSE -- it is N/A because the gating field was deliberately removed from the schema version v10 actually resolves.

missingFields.expectedOn: every artifact's metadata object (schema allows it)
missingFields.genuineDefectOrOutOfContract: OUT_OF_CONTRACT -- contentHash is populated only at publish time by CatalogStamper/CatalogBundleAssembler tooling, never authored by hand; all catalog/ source files are pre-publish DRAFT documents, so its absence here is expected, not a defect.

missingFields.field: public workout-type mapping (catalog workout key -> GeneratedCatalogWorkoutType or TrainingDayType)
missingFields.expectedOn: backend domain layer, for every one of the 5 catalog workout keys reachable from v10
missingFields.genuineDefectOrOutOfContract: OUT_OF_CONTRACT for the catalog itself (no catalog schema claims to define this); a genuine, already-documented gap on the backend side (PlanCatalogDomainMapper.ClassifyWorkoutKeys), explicitly classified RequiresNewField for all 5 keys, not newly discovered by this audit.

OUT_OF_CONTRACT -- explicitly not yet part of the current schema; the schema explicitly FORBIDS weekNumber/calendarDate/week fields on any stage, confirming catalog authoring intentionally stays phase-relative only.

missingFields.field: structural role -> exact workout key mapping
missingFields.genuineDefectOrOutOfContract: OUT_OF_CONTRACT today; only family-level closure coverage is validated (LAYOUT_SLOT_HAS_NO_ELIGIBLE_WORKOUT), never a specific stage/workout assignment per role.

openDecisions: How the LONG_RUN structural role's session is ever produced by any future scheduler, given zero stages in v10's progression target the LONG_RUN workout family.

Whether/how the future IWorkoutStageScheduler should read phaseAllocation.compressionPriority/extensionPriority (phase-level, present in TEN_K_MASTER v6) versus the entirely absent stage-level distribution/extension-priority/tie-break fields (not present at any version).

Terminal behavior when a fallback chain's final stage is itself ineligible -- not reachable in v10's actual data (CURRENT_FITNESS_SPECIFIC_REHEARSAL has no requires), but unspecified in the contract for any future stage that does have a conditional fallback target.
Whether workoutCandidates array order should ever be treated as a ranking/preference signal once a stage has more than one candidate (no v10 stage currently has more than one, so this is untested).
